description:
### Fixes
- GmsCore support: LinkedIn push notifications work again. Google refused the patched app's push registration, so no notification ever arrived; it now registers with MicroG-RE like the original app.

**23 patches in total.** Full list in the [README](https://github.com/lokesh-sparrow/loki-patches#patches).

patches.name: AMOLED black bars
patches.description: Turns the dark top bar, bottom bar, side menu and the other screens the app draws pure black, matching the feed that the AMOLED black setting already covers. Needs Material You.

patches.name: Anonymous profile viewing
patches.description: Adds an option (off by default, experimental) to visit profiles without being listed in "Who viewed your profile": the analytics events of profile pages are not sent.

patches.name: Block tracking
patches.description: Adds a switch (off by default) that stops most of LinkedIn's analytics events from being sent.

patches.name: Copy text
patches.description: Long press a post, comment or any other text to select and copy it in place, like on Reddit.

patches.name: Dark app icon
patches.description: Black launcher icon with the white "in", instead of LinkedIn's blue. Chosen when patching: a launcher icon cannot switch with dark mode on its own.

patches.name: Disable double-tap like
patches.description: A double tap on a post or a photo no longer likes it.

patches.name: Download media
patches.description: Puts a download button in the full screen photo, video and document viewer; documents (PDFs and carousels) are saved as a single PDF.

patches.name: Feed filters
patches.description: Adds a set of filters that are off until turned on in Loki Patches: focus mode, celebrations, job cards, reposts, posts from other people's activity, "Recommended for you", video posts, games, the "New posts" pill and "See translation".

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Routes "Continue with Google" through microG RE (GmsCore) instead of Google Play services, so signing in works in patched LinkedIn. microG RE has to be installed and signed in to a Google account.

patches.name: Hide Premium upsells
patches.description: Drops the Premium and AI upsell cards and banners, on profiles and in the Me panel too.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes sponsored (promoted) posts from the feed.

patches.name: Hide bottom tabs
patches.description: Adds switches to take My Network and Jobs out of the bottom bar.

patches.name: Hide promoted jobs
patches.description: Drops promoted job listings from the Jobs tab and from job searches.

patches.name: Hide suggested posts
patches.description: Drops the "Suggested" posts from people outside your network.

patches.name: Keep feed on reopen
patches.description: Keeps your place in the feed when you come back to LinkedIn, instead of reloading it. Pull down or tap the "New posts" button to load new posts.

patches.name: Material You
patches.description: Takes the colors from your wallpaper (Android 12+): the accent replaces LinkedIn blue and the green of the selected filters, and the backgrounds, cards, bars and borders become Material 3 surfaces. Some screens LinkedIn draws from its servers may keep their own colors.

patches.name: Messaging
patches.description: Drops sponsored messages from the inbox, and adds an optional ghost mode that sends no typing indicators and no read receipts.

patches.name: Open links directly
patches.description: Skips LinkedIn's safety/go warning page and opens external links straight away.

patches.name: Post menu items
patches.description: Adds Copy text, Download photos and videos, and Save document as PDF to the ⋯ menu of posts.

patches.name: Remove gaps and dividers
patches.description: Removes the gray gaps between posts and the dividers between list items, so the feed and the lists read as one flat surface.

patches.name: Sanitize share links
patches.description: Strips the tracking parameters from LinkedIn links that get copied or shared.

patches.name: Swipe between feeds
patches.description: Swipe left and right on the home feed to switch between For you and Network, like on X.

patches.name: Tap to hide in viewers
patches.description: Tap a video or document in full screen to hide the caption and buttons, like photos.

release_notes:
### New Features
- Dark app icon: optional black launcher icon (off by default).

### Fixes
- Swipe between feeds: My Network tabs now switch reliably on every screen size, including Catch up after Search.

**23 patches in total.** Full list in the [README](https://github.com/lokesh-sparrow/loki-patches#patches).
